items.title: INSTALL ENGINE WITH TRANSMISSION IN VEHICLE

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Attach the engine hoist chain to the lifting brackets on the engine.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Lower the engine into the engine compartment.

substeps.label: (c)
substeps.text: Align the engine with the transmission and engine mounting supports.

substeps.label: (d)
substeps.text: Install the engine mounting bolts on each side of the engine.

items.title: INSTALL ENGINE REAR SUPPORT MEMBER WITH GROUND STRAP TO BODY
INSTALL INTERMEDIATE SHAFT TO PROPELLER SHAFT

substeps.label: (b)

substeps.label: (c)
substeps.text: Install the sliding yoke and two lock bolts.

items.title: CONNECT BATTERY GROUND STRAP TO ENGINE MOUNTING BRACKET
INSTALL STIFFENER PLATE WITH GROUND STRAP
